newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gujing to issue 50 mln new B shares.
newsitem.headline: Gujing to issue 50 mln new B shares.

text.p: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd said on Wednesday it planned to issue 50 million additional hard currency B shares.

The company will present the plan to shareholders at a meeting on May 23 before submitting it to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for final approval, Gujing said in a statement in Wednesday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
Shareholders will also vote on a plan to turn the firm into a foreign-invested company, Gujing said but gave no details.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
Gujing had 235 million outstanding shares at the end of 1996, consisting of 155 million state shares, 20 million domestic A shares and 60 million B shares, according to the firm's 1996 annual report.
Gujing posted a net profit of 169.37 million yuan for 1996, against 145.13 million yuan for 1995 under international accounting standards.
Trading in Gujing's A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning for the announcement.
